messages:
Ivy (PM): quick thread to lock DP prioritization + launch gates for the upcoming pilot. want to avoid last-wave churn and make recruitment predictable.
Tess (PartnerOps): proposal: two parallel funnels = (1) high-signal partners (strategic/manual outreach) and (2) open-applicants (self-serve). cap high-signal at 12, open-applicants to fill remainder.
Marco (Eng): capacity note: we can support 8 active pilots/week without burst. if a strategic partner needs dedicated throughput, need a signed pilot SLA + 72h advance notice.
Gita (Res): research asks: require 3 canonical prompts + a short demo video or run transcript for high-signal partners. for open-applicants, at least 1 prompt + proposed success metric.
Ivy (PM): scoring rubric idea for intake (0-5 each): technical fit, business impact, data sensitivity, onboarding readiness. threshold >=12 to be direct-invite; 9-11 goes to waitlist + nurture.
Tess (PartnerOps): intake flow draft: 
```
- Company + contact
- Use case (1-2 lines)
- 1-3 sample prompts
- Expected weekly tokens
- Any compliance flags (GDPR/PHI/FIN)
- Preferred cohort window
```
Evan (Legal): compliance flow: checkbox to trigger extra review. PHI/FIN flagged -> require legal sign-off before kickoff. NDA should be presented inline with intake and have a "Sign now" CTA.
Marco (Eng): infra automation: when intake meets threshold and NDA signed -> provision sandbox + temp API key + default quotas. invite-bot will post summary to #dp-cohort-X.
invite-bot: automation: auto-score intake (per rubric), post score + link to intake row; ping PO when score >=12.
Gita (Res): launch gates per cohort: (A) 70% of cohort RSVPs, (B) at least 60% of partners complete smoke-eval, (C) synthetic quality metric >= baseline on seed prompts, (D) onboarding docs + runbook validated.
Ivy (PM): add productization signal: at least 2 feature requests with clear reproducible steps and customer value >= medium. those count toward roadmap input.
Tess (PartnerOps): incentives: baseline = 300 credits + 1 research call. milestone credit 500 if partner completes 3 weekly evals and a feedback interview. co-marketing only for enterprise-tier partners.
Evan (Legal): privacy note: include explicit telemetry opt-in (checkbox) and short explanation. no logs shared by default. if partner opts in, capture anonymized logs; store per agreed residency.
Marco (Eng): dev ops: freeze model/quant profile 48h before cohort start. also provide a standby fallback model for any regressions; rollback must be executable within 30m and communicated to partners.
Gita (Res): signal hygiene: maintain a canonical seed-set per cohort; require partners to label prompts as "happy/edge/adversarial". automated eval passes if >=50% of happy-path prompts meet quality threshold.
Ivy (PM): prioritization policy for invites: 1) strategic partners with exec sponsor, 2) high technical fit score, 3) partners with novel stress patterns that exercise infra. lower-priority gets waitlist + newsletter.
Tess (PartnerOps): messaging copy bias: short subject, clear CTA, timeline bullets. add a small FAQ link (NDA, data handling, expected time). auto-remind at day 4 and day 9; last manual nudge day 11.
Evan (Legal): flag: any public sector or healthcare leads require added terms; add a checkbox for that at intake.
Marco (Eng): will add a webhook to post quota + smoke-eval summary to cohort channel. rate-limited to avoid spamming.
Ivy (PM): success metrics for the pilot wave (the things we'll report at launch review): - filled seats >= 18/24 within 3 weeks, - average weekly active usage >= 150 tokens/partner, - at least 6 productizable asks, - partner satisfaction >= 30 NPS, - infra incidents <= 2 (severity>=2).
Gita (Res): also track signal quality delta vs baseline (median quality +5% target). if not achieved, pause next cohort for config iterate.
Tess (PartnerOps): owners: Tess = intake & comms, Marco = infra & automation, Gita = eval config, Evan = legal intake text, Ivy = cohort prioritization & launch review.
Ivy (PM): next steps: Tess to publish intake form + scoring sheet by EOD Wed; Marco to wireup webhook and sandbox provisioning by Fri; Gita to share seed prompt templates by Fri. I'll schedule a 20-min send-review Mon morning. Any objections? :seedling:
